description: Structured accessibility analysis output for a UI screenshot, containing detected UI elements and associated accessibility issues.

version.description: Schema version. Must match the expected contract version to ensure compatibility with validation and processing logic.

meta.description: Metadata describing the analysis execution and summarising key findings.

elements.description: List of UI elements detected in the screenshot. Each element represents a meaningful, user-relevant component of the interface. Accessibility issues are assigned to each UI element.

flags.description: Global accessibility issues or low-confidence findings not tied to a specific UI element. Includes systemic issues or uncertain detections.

meta.description: Metadata about the analysis run, including input identification and high-level summary.

designFile.description: Details of the analysed image file.

modelName.description: Name of the model used to perform the analysis.

timestampStart.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds representing when the analysis started.

timestampEnd.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds representing when the analysis completed.

prompt.description: A concise summary of the instructions used to guide the analysis.

keyFindings.description: A brief (1–2 sentence) summary of the most significant accessibility issues identified.

name.description: The original file name including extension.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

element.description: A UI element detected in the image, with inferred semantics based on visual structure and accessibility best practices.

tag.description: The inferred semantic HTML element or ARIA role that best represents this UI component. Must be selected from a predefined set of valid roles.

name.description: Accessible name or visible label of the element as perceived by users (e.g. button text, input label, link text, region name).

description.description: A concise description of the purpose of the element from the user's perspective.

boundingBox.description: Approximate bounding box of the element within the image, using pixel coordinates relative to the top-left corner.

confidence.description: Represents the model's confidence that this UI element has been correctly detected and semantically classified. See ai/docs/a11y.confidence-scoring.md for confidence scoring guidelines.

id.description: Unique, incremental identifier used by other elements to reference this element. For example: he_001, he_002, he_003, lm_001, lm_002, lm_003, ui_001, ui_002, ui_003.

contains.description: List of direct descendent element ids.

items.description: The unique id of the element.

issue.description: Accessibility issue associated with this element. Only included for high-confidence, impactful findings.

boundingBox.description: Approximate bounding box of the element within the image. Coordinates are estimated based on visual analysis and should be treated as indicative rather than pixel-perfect.

x.description: Horizontal position from the top edge of the image to the top-left corner of the element. Percentage value relative to the width of the image.

y.description: Vertical position from the top edge of the image to the top-left corner of the element. Percentage value relative to the height of the image.

width.description: Approximate width of the element in percentage relative to the width of the image.

height.description: Approximate height of the element in percentage relative to the height of the image.

issue.description: A detected accessibility issue aligned with WCAG criteria.

severity.description: Severity of the issue. See ai/docs/a11y.severity-levels.md for full definitions.

title.description: Short, descriptive name of the issue.

wcag.description: List of WCAG success criteria violated by this issue.

items.description: WCAG success criterion number in the format X.X.X (e.g. 1.4.3).

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue and its impact on users, including affected user groups where relevant.

fix.description: Actionable guidance describing how to resolve the issue in design or implementation.

confidence.description: Represents the model's confidence that this accessibility issue is present and correctly mapped to the specified WCAG criteria. See ai/docs/a11y.confidence-scoring.md for confidence scoring guidelines.

widgetRoles.description: ARIA widget roles representing interactive components.

documentStructureRoles.description: ARIA roles describing document structure elements.

landmarkRoles.description: Landmark roles used to define major regions of the page for assistive technologies.

liveRegionRoles.description: Roles used to indicate dynamic content updates to assistive technologies.

windowRoles.description: Roles representing modal or dialog containers.

legacyRoles.description: Legacy or less commonly used ARIA roles.

confidence.$comment: See ai/docs/a11y.confidence-scoring.md for confidence scoring guidelines.
confidence.description: Represents the model's confidence in a detection or finding, including both a quantitative score and a justification.

level.description: Confidence score ranging from 0 (no confidence) to 1 (extremely high confidence). Must align with the defined confidence ranges.

reason.description: Explanation of why this confidence level was assigned, based on visual clarity, semantic certainty, and strength of inference.
